Four of the six reviewer hypotheses supplied in the spawn prompt were refuted with evidence (contextvar non-unwind, bare asserts under -O, per-request Settings(), and the loggerDict-once gap for the common propagating case). E11-S1 and the Money type are clean; no file exceeds 300 lines and no function exceeds 24.
